title.value: On Neural Architecture Inductive Biases for Relational Tasks
title.justification: The paper introduces a model called Compositional Relational Network (CoRelNet) and explores the inductive biases in neural architectures for relational tasks.
title.quote: We introduce a simple architecture based on similarity scores which we name Compositional Relational Network (CoRelNet).

extractions.description: The paper investigates the inductive biases in neural architectures for relational tasks, introducing the Compositional Relational Network (CoRelNet) model. It focuses on how separating relational representations from sensory data can enhance out-of-distribution generalization in relational tasks.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on improving machine learning models' performance on relational tasks, particularly their out-of-distribution generalization capabilities. It does not address any specific environmental or ecological challenges.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: The paper primarily addresses the challenges of in-distribution and out-of-distribution generalization in deep learning models for relational tasks, without mentioning sustainability.
